en_title: EA Confirms DICE and Respawn Are Collaborating on a New Project Amidst Star Wars: Battlefront 3 Rumors
cn_title: 《星球大战》EA确认DICE与Respawn合作新项目
subtitle: 续作传闻升温
opus_summary: EA确认DICE与Respawn正在合作开发新项目，外界猜测该项目可能是《星球大战：前线3》。EA尚未公布具体内容与发售时间，而BioWare则将关闭并取消《质量效应》系列新作。

paragraphs.en: EA has confirmed that DICE and Respawn are working on a new project together, adding more fuel to rumors about Star Wars: Battlefront 3 .
paragraphs.cn: EA确认，DICE与Respawn正在合作开发新项目，进一步加剧了外界对《星球大战：前线3》的传闻。

paragraphs.en: As part of a larger letter about the future of EA, the publisher confirmed that it is working on new Battlefield games. It also noted that in addition to Battlefield, DICE and Respawn are working together on a "future project" that they hope will unlock growth in their shooter portfolio. This follows rumors from earlier this week that the two companies are working together to make Star Wars: Battlefront 3.
paragraphs.cn: EA在一封讨论公司未来的长篇信件中确认，正在开发新的《战地风云》游戏。EA还表示，除了《战地风云》新作外，DICE与Respawn也在合作开发一个「未来项目」，希望借此推动旗下射击游戏业务增长。本周早些时候已有传闻称，两家工作室正在合作开发《星球大战：前线3》。

paragraphs.en: "In addition to our future Battlefield titles, we’ll be bringing together our Respawn and DICE studios to collaborate on a future project that will help us achieve that ambition," said EA. "We can’t wait to share more when the time comes."
paragraphs.cn: EA表示：「除了未来的《战地风云》作品外，我们还将让Respawn与DICE两家工作室展开合作，共同开发一个未来项目，帮助我们实现这一目标。时机成熟后，我们迫不及待地想与大家分享更多信息。」

paragraphs.en: Variety also corroborated the Battlefront 3 rumors via sources, though nothing was shared on what the game will look like or when it might release. Other rumors recently suggested that Bungie was in the mix to work on Battlefront 3 or perhaps another project in the Star Wars universe, though nothing has been confirmed on that front. Star Wars: Battlefront 3 has been one of the most demanded titles over the last decade.
paragraphs.cn: 《综艺》也通过消息源印证了《星球大战：前线3》的传闻，但目前没有消息透露这款游戏会是什么样，也没有公布可能的发售时间。近期还有其他传闻称，Bungie可能参与开发《星球大战：前线3》，或是星球大战宇宙中的另一款作品，但相关消息尚未得到确认。在过去十年里，《星球大战：前线3》一直是玩家呼声最高的作品之一。

paragraphs.en: DICE's second crack at the Star Wars shooter franchise was controversial at launch due to issues with its monetization strategy , but the game itself was praised up and down by fans. It has remained a respected title among Star Wars lovers, and they've frequently rallied together to demand a sequel . Now, it seems like it will happen, though this time with the assistance of Respawn.
paragraphs.cn: DICE第二次涉足星球大战射击游戏系列时，曾因商业化策略问题在发售之初引发争议，但游戏本身获得了玩家的一致好评。它至今仍受到星球大战爱好者的认可，玩家也曾多次联合起来要求推出续作。如今，这一愿望似乎可能成真，只是这次将有Respawn参与其中。

paragraphs.en: The Titanfall and Apex Legends studio has its own experience working on Star Wars through the Jedi games and the recently-released Star Wars Zero Company. Respawn also worked on a canceled Star Wars shooter, rumored to be a Mandalorian game, leaving fans to wonder what could've been. Only time will tell what this new Respawn and DICE game really is, but if it's Battlefront 3, it has serious potential to be something special.
paragraphs.cn: 这家《泰坦陨落》和《Apex英雄》开发商曾通过《星球大战绝地》系列以及最近推出的《星球大战 零号连队》积累了开发星球大战作品的经验。Respawn还曾参与开发一款后来取消的星球大战射击游戏，据传那是一款曼达洛人题材作品，这也让玩家不禁猜想它原本可能会是什么样。这个Respawn与DICE合作开发的新项目究竟是什么，只能交给时间揭晓；但如果它真的是《星球大战：前线3》，就很有潜力成为一款特别的作品。

paragraphs.en: This news came alongside some doom and gloom. EA confirmed that it was canceling the next Mass Effect and shutting down veteran RPG studio BioWare . The news comes after about a decade of commercial and critical misfires from the studio with games like Mass Effect: Andromeda, Anthem, and Dragon Age: The Veilguard.
paragraphs.cn: 这则消息也伴随着一些令人沮丧的内容。EA确认取消下一款《质量效应》游戏，并关闭资深RPG工作室BioWare。过去约十年间，该工作室推出了《质量效应：仙女座》、《圣歌》和《龙腾世纪：影障守护者》等作品，但商业表现和口碑均不尽如人意。
